name: marketing-site
description: Zengin's own marketing page, built on @zenginui/ui with a distinct brand through tokens, and enforced by the engine it advertises.

scripts.dev: node ../../packages/cli/dist/index.js registry build --out public/r && node scripts/build-previews.mjs && node ../../packages/cli/dist/index.js rollup ../../reports --format html --out public/rollup/index.html && vite --port 5174
scripts.build: node ../../packages/cli/dist/index.js registry build --out public/r && node scripts/build-previews.mjs --storybook && node ../../packages/cli/dist/index.js rollup ../../reports --format html --out public/rollup/index.html && vite build
